subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Day of the Dead
description: A quick win: understand Day of the Dead.

hook.text: Every November, Mexico sets tables for the dead. Marigold paths guide spirits home. Skulls smile.

buildup.text: Día de los Muertos blends Aztec and Catholic traditions. Death is celebrated, not feared.

discovery.text: Families build ofrendas with photos, favorite foods, and drinks. The dead are honored as guests, not ghosts.

twist.text: The festival insists the dead want to visit. Grief transforms into hospitality. Loss becomes a reunion.

climax.text: Day of the Dead reframes death as a relationship that continues. Mourning and celebration coexist.

punchline.text: Set a plate. They're coming home.

quiz.question: What is an ofrenda?
options: An altar with offerings for the dead
